# BH-700 Kiln Baghouse: Control Narrative (Draft A)

**Module:** BH-700 Baghouse | **Requirement prefix:** FR-BH700 | **Status:** Draft for process, controls, and operations review

This draft converts the shift supervisor's email into testable requirements. Some statements in the email are informal or conflicting, so they are open items (Section 10). The integrator can build the structure from this draft. Do not run FAT until operations signs off on the setpoint list and open items OI-01 through OI-06 are closed.

---

## 1. Purpose and boundaries

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BH700-001 | BH-700 removes dust from kiln exhaust gas and discharges collected dust through RV-702 to SC-701. | Inspection |
| FR-BH700-002 | Upstream interface: kiln exhaust gas enters through D-704. Bleed air enters through D-706. | Inspection |
| FR-BH700-003 | Downstream interface: F-703 discharges clean gas. SC-701 discharges dust to the dust handling system (destination: OI-10). | Inspection |
| FR-BH700-004 | BH-700 sends a kiln feed stop request to the kiln module. The kiln module owns the kiln feed stop action. | FAT (simulated interface) |

## 2. Equipment and tags

Refer to the instrument index for ranges, I/O, and fail positions. This narrative uses these tags: SC-701, RV-702, F-703, D-704, TT-705, D-706. The baghouse DP transmitter, the RV-702 motion switch, and the kiln feed interface tags are not yet assigned (OI-07).

## 3. States and transitions (ISA-106)

| State | Entry permissives | Initiator | Allowed exits | Automation level |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| STOPPED | No active trip. Trip reset by operator. | Auto (end of STOPPING) or operator RESET from TRIPPED | STARTING | Manual |
| STARTING | STOPPED, all start permissives in the C&E chart met | Operator START | RUNNING, STOPPING, TRIPPED | Automatic (SEQ-1) |
| RUNNING | SEQ-1 complete | Auto | STOPPING, TRIPPED | Automatic |
| STOPPING | RUNNING or STARTING, operator confirms kiln feed stopped (OI-05) | Operator STOP | STOPPED, TRIPPED | Operator-prompted, then automatic (SEQ-2) |
| TRIPPED | Any trip cause in the C&E chart | Auto | STOPPED (cause clear plus operator RESET) | Automatic entry, manual reset |

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BH700-010 | The BPCS shall allow only the transitions in the state table above. | FAT: attempt each disallowed transition |
| FR-BH700-011 | The BPCS shall not restart BH-700 automatically from TRIPPED or after power restore. | FAT |
| FR-BH700-012 | The BPCS shall show the current state, active step, and step timer on the BH-700 faceplate. | FAT |

## 4. Regulatory and discrete control

### 4.1 Pulse cleaning

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BH700-020 | The BPCS shall pulse one row at a time, in rotation, at the normal pulse interval. | FAT: measure interval |
| FR-BH700-021 | The BPCS shall change to the fast pulse interval when baghouse DP is above the DP high setpoint for the DP high delay. | FAT: ramp simulated DP |
| FR-BH700-022 | The BPCS shall return to the normal pulse interval when baghouse DP is below the DP high reset setpoint. | FAT |
| FR-BH700-023 | The BPCS shall enable pulse cleaning only in RUNNING and STOPPING. | FAT |

### 4.2 Inlet temperature protection (TT-705 / D-706)

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BH700-030 | The BPCS shall open D-706 when TT-705 is above the bleed-air open setpoint. | FAT |
| FR-BH700-031 | The BPCS shall close D-706 when TT-705 is below the bleed-air reset setpoint. | FAT |
| FR-BH700-032 | D-706 control mode (on/off or modulating TIC) is open item OI-08. Do not program until closed. | — |

## 5. Sequences

### SEQ-1: Start (STARTING)

Start order is downstream first, as described in the email. The alternate fan-first order is OI-01.

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Start SC-701 | SC-701 running feedback | Motor start timeout | Alarm. Go to STOPPED. |
| 2 | Start RV-702 | RV-702 running feedback and motion | Motor start timeout | Alarm. Stop SC-701. Go to STOPPED. |
| 3 | Start F-703 | F-703 running feedback and at speed | Fan start timeout | Alarm. Stop RV-702, then SC-701. Go to STOPPED. |
| 4 | Wait | Fan-to-damper delay complete | — (fixed timer) | Trip causes stay active. |
| 5 | Open D-704 | D-704 open limit | Damper travel timeout | Alarm. Hold. Prompt operator: RETRY or STOP. |
| 6 | Enable pulse cleaning at normal interval | Pulse cleaning active | Pulse enable timeout | Alarm. Hold. Prompt operator: RETRY or STOP. |
| 7 | Go to RUNNING | — | — | — |

### SEQ-2: Clean-down stop (STOPPING)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Prompt operator to confirm kiln feed stopped | Operator confirms (or kiln feed stopped signal, OI-05) | None (operator hold) | Stay in step. Operator can cancel to RUNNING. |
| 2 | Continue pulse cleaning with F-703 running and D-704 open (OI-02) | Clean-down timer complete | — (fixed timer) | Trip causes stay active. |
| 3 | Stop pulse cleaning | Pulse cleaning inactive | Pulse stop timeout | Alarm. Continue. |
| 4 | Close D-704 | D-704 closed limit | Damper travel timeout | Alarm. Continue. |
| 5 | Stop F-703 | F-703 stopped feedback | Motor stop timeout | Alarm. Continue. |
| 6 | Run RV-702 and SC-701 | Hopper run-on timer complete (OI-03) | — (fixed timer) | Trip causes stay active. |
| 7 | Stop RV-702 | RV-702 stopped feedback | Motor stop timeout | Alarm. Continue. |
| 8 | Stop SC-701 | SC-701 stopped feedback | Motor stop timeout | Alarm. Go to STOPPED. |

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BH700-040 | The BPCS shall execute SEQ-1 in step order with the timeouts and failure responses in the table. | FAT: run each step and force each failure |
| FR-BH700-041 | The BPCS shall execute SEQ-2 in step order with the timeouts and failure responses in the table. | FAT: run each step and force each failure |

## 6. Interlocks and permissives

Refer to the BH-700 cause-and-effect chart. The rows below are **draft input to that chart**, not narrative logic. The process hazard review must confirm them (OI-04).

| C&E row | Cause | Effect (draft) |
|---|---|---|
| C-01 | RV-702 not running or motion lost, in STARTING, RUNNING, or STOPPING | Kiln feed stop request. Close D-704. Stop F-703 (see OI-04). Go to TRIPPED. Alarm. |
| C-02 | SC-701 not running, in STARTING, RUNNING, or STOPPING | Stop RV-702. Effects of C-01 follow. |
| C-03 | Baghouse DP above DP high-high setpoint | Kiln feed stop request. Alarm. |
| C-04 | F-703 trip in RUNNING | Kiln feed stop request. Go to TRIPPED. Alarm. Kiln-side effects: OI-09. |

## 7. Alarms

Refer to the rationalized alarm database (ISA-18.2) for BH-700 alarm limits, priorities, and responses. Candidates for rationalization: DP high, DP high-high, TT-705 high, RV-702 motion loss, sequence step timeouts, bad PV on DP and TT-705.

## 8. Abnormal handling

| ID | Condition | Required response | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-BH700-050 | Bad PV, baghouse DP | Change to fast pulse interval. Alarm. Inhibit C-03 automatic action and alarm (OI-04 to confirm). | FAT: force bad quality |
| FR-BH700-051 | Bad PV, TT-705 | Open D-706. Alarm. | FAT: force bad quality |
| FR-BH700-052 | Loss of comms to BH-700 controller or I/O | Field devices go to fail positions in the instrument index. Alarm at HMI. | FAT: disconnect |
| FR-BH700-053 | Power loss and restore | Go to STOPPED, or TRIPPED if a cause is active. No automatic restart. | FAT: power cycle |
| FR-BH700-054 | Fail positions | Proposed: D-706 fail open, D-704 per OI-11. Confirm in the instrument index. | Inspection |

## 9. Operator interface

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BH700-060 | The faceplate shall have START, STOP, RESET, and RETRY commands. | FAT |
| FR-BH700-061 | The faceplate shall show state, step, step timer, baghouse DP, pulse interval mode, TT-705, and D-704/D-706 positions. | FAT |
| FR-BH700-062 | The HMI shall prompt the operator to confirm kiln feed stopped at SEQ-2 Step 1. | FAT |
| FR-BH700-063 | The HMI shall prompt RETRY or STOP at SEQ-1 Steps 5 and 6 failures. | FAT |
| FR-BH700-064 | Operator access to the setpoint list is open item OI-12. | — |

Operations must sign off on Section 3 states and Section 9 prompts before FAT.

---

### Notes for the review meeting

- **The email's "usually shut the kiln feed" at high DP was a manual action.** This draft makes it an automatic kiln feed stop request (C-03). Operations and process must agree to that change.
- **"Shut everything down quick" on airlock failure is the most important item.** The email ties it to a past fire. Treat it as a candidate safety function until the hazard review says otherwise (OI-04). Stopping F-703 also affects kiln draft (OI-09), so the trip effects are not purely a baghouse decision.
- **The SC-701 trip (C-02) is my addition, not from the email.** If SC-701 stops, RV-702 discharges into a stopped conveyor and the hopper fills the same way.
